retrieval_matched_chunks: ["Lotus Technology has a dedicated global team to support its R&D activities with a sizable scale and comprehensive functionalities, covering all major technological perspectives. Centered around Lotus Technology's global headquarters in Wuhan, China, which focuses on cloud computing and online data processing, the company operates a software center in Shanghai focusing on global system integration and network security, and a research institute in Ningbo focusing on electric architecture, charging and power systems, and intelligent driving. Lotus Technology has established two R&D centers on engineering and product design, including the Lotus Technology Creative Centre (LTCC) located in the heart of the British car industry in Coventry, U.K., with a focus on automotive design and design strategy, product and brand communication, and sustainable material science, and the Lotus Technology Innovative Centre (LTIC) located in Frankfurt, Germany, with a focus on behavioral science, innovative vehicle technologies, dynamic attribute development, user interface, and regional tuning and application.", "Lotus Technology's research and development efforts are focusing on the development of key electric vehicle technologies while benefiting from the technological support from the Geely Holding ecosystem. As of December 31, 2023, Lotus Technology's R&D team consisted of 1,802 professionals with extensive knowledge in automotive engineering, software, and artificial intelligence, as well as diversified working experiences from leading vehicle manufacturers globally. Such composition ensures solid technology development capabilities, especially in intelligence and digitalization. The diversified cultural and professional background promotes the exchange of ideas from different perspectives and ensures the generation of innovations.", "In October 2023, Lotus Technology's wholly foreign-owned enterprise (WFOE) pledged the land use rights, buildings, and ancillary facilities on certain pieces of land totaling approximately 84,000 square meters where Lotus Technology's global headquarters is located in Wuhan, China, to the Jingkai Fund pursuant to an exchangeable note agreement entered into between the WFOE and the Jingkai Fund in September 2021. Such pledge was terminated in April 2024 following the listing of Lotus Technology's securities on Nasdaq pursuant to the terms of the pledge. Lotus Technology maintains property insurance, public liability insurance, commercial general liability insurance, employer’s liability insurance, driver’s liability insurance, and inland transit insurance. In addition to providing social security insurance for employees as required by applicable laws, Lotus Technology also provides supplemental commercial medical insurance for employees. Lotus Technology does not maintain business interruption insurance or key-man insurance. Lotus Technology believes that its insurance coverage is adequate to cover key assets, facilities, and liabilities."]

retrieval_matched_chunks: ["Additionally, many of these competitors also have greater name recognition, longer operating histories, larger sales forces, broader customer and industry relationships, and other tangible and intangible resources that exceed those of Lotus Technology. question_en: What are the key achievements of Lotus Technology in 2024?
retrieval_matched_chunks: ["New York – November 12, 2024 – Lotus Technology Inc. (“Lotus” or the “Company”), a leading global intelligent and luxury mobility provider, today announced its vehicle delivery results for the first ten months of 2024. Lotus Technology Inc. continues to achieve top-rate growth among traditional luxury car brands, delivering 8,631 vehicles in the first ten months of 2024. Europe and China continued to be the major markets for Lotus Technology, with each region contributing about 35% and 25% of the total deliveries, respectively. In October, Lotus Technology Inc. started an open beta test for its urban NOA (Navigate on Autopilot) in key cities. Certain over-the-air updates of intelligent driving, including highway assistant driving functions, were launched in Europe. As previously announced, Lotus Robotics, Lotus Technology's intelligent driving arm, provides intelligent driving solutions with global coverage to both Lotus-brand intelligent vehicles and other global leading auto conglomerates such as Lynk&Co, Farizon Auto, and a top Japanese Tier-one supplier. In October, Lotus Technology Inc. was awarded the Highly Commends honor at the Reuters Sustainability Awards 2024 in the Business Transformation category as the only awardee from the automotive industry. Note 1: Invoiced deliveries, including commissioned deliveries in the US market.", "Over 7,600 vehicles were delivered in the first nine months of 2024, a year-on-year increase of 136%. Total revenue reached $653 million, more than doubling year-on-year. Revenue from the intelligent driving business generated from customers other than Lotus surged to $11 million, with a year-on-year growth of 450%. Lotus Technology launched Hyper Hybrid EV technology that provides high performance with a combined range of over 1,100 kilometers. New York – Nov 21, 2024 – Lotus Technology Inc. (“Lotus Tech” or the “Company”), a leading global intelligent and luxury mobility provider, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter and first nine months ended September 30, 2024.", "How was Lotus Technology's performance in the first half of the year? Total revenue for the first half of 2024 was $398 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 206%. Lotus Technology's Average Selling Price (ASP) remained above $100,000, achieving growth far exceeding the industry and luxury car segment. Lotus Technology's gross margin for the first half of this year was 13%, compared to 5% in the same period of 2023. In the first half of 2024, Lotus Technology achieved total product deliveries of 4,873 units, a 239% year-on-year increase, making it the fastest-growing brand among traditional luxury car brands. Global deliveries were balanced, with the four major markets (Europe, China, North America, and Rest of World) each contributing 20-30% of deliveries. In the first half of 2024, as Lotus Technology began collaborating with several leading automotive brands by providing intelligent driving solutions and technology development services, technology-related revenue started to expand. With the continued increase in cumulative deliveries of lifestyle vehicles equipped with advanced hardware, the potential for generating paid software subscription revenue continues to grow. Lotus Technology launched the Colin Chapman Bespoke Service, offering personalized options, designer customization, limited editions, and exclusive customization to meet the growing demands of its customers. The delivery of customized models is expected to further enhance the brand's luxury positioning and benefit Lotus Technology's long-term profit margins.", "The strategy focuses on six key fields: Nature Positive, Climate Neutrality, Sustainable Supply Chain, Inclusion and Equality, Community Commitment, and Transparent Governance. Lotus Technology joined the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) in May 2023 and has set targets aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) for each field, embedding actionable frameworks into its operations to achieve the global goals. In June 2024, Lotus Technology was recognized by the Global Zero Carbon City Pioneer Awards at the 2024 Shanghai International Carbon Neutrality Expo for its innovation and exceptional commitment to sustainability and responsible business practices. Additionally, Lotus Technology was nominated as a finalist in the business and operations transformation categories at the Reuters Sustainability Awards 2024, demonstrating global recognition of its holistic approach to sustainability."]

The first of Lotus Technology's core Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) commitments is that, throughout the Lotus product line, all future new mainstream vehicles from Lotus Technology and from Lotus UK will be fully electric. retrieval_matched_chunks: ["In addition, regardless of their veracity, reports of unauthorized access to the vehicles, their systems, or data, as well as other factors that may result in the perception that the vehicles, their systems, or data are capable of being “hacked,” could negatively affect Lotus Technology's brand and harm its business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. Lotus Technology retains certain information about its customers, which may subject the company to complex and evolving laws and regulations regarding cybersecurity, privacy, data protection, and information security in various jurisdictions in which it operates. Lotus Technology uses its vehicles’ electronic systems to log, with necessary permission, certain information about each vehicle’s use in order to aid Lotus Technology in vehicle diagnostics, repair, and maintenance, as well as to help optimize the driving and riding experiences. Lotus Technology's customers may object to the use of this data, which may harm the company’s business. Lotus Technology has adopted strict information security policies and deployed advanced security measures to comply with these requirements and to prevent data loss and other security breaches, including, among others, advanced encryption technologies.", "Lotus Technology prioritizes the trust of its customers and employees and places great emphasis on systems and product security, cybersecurity, and privacy. To protect its systems, products, and data, Lotus Technology applies a variety of technical and organizational security policies, procedures, technical controls, and protocols. Lotus Technology has a dedicated team of professionals that focuses on application, network, system, and product security based upon a clearly defined organizational operating model. Lotus Technology has obtained the ISO/IEC 27001 certifications (GB/T 22080-2016) and R155/R156 certifications. Lotus Technology has also commenced corporate-wide data privacy policies and controls with dedicated cross-functional resources. Lotus Technology implements enterprise vulnerability management processes that include periodic scans designed to identify security vulnerabilities and implement remediation. In addition, Lotus Technology conducts internal and external penetration tests, receives threat intelligence, follows incident response procedures, and remediates vulnerabilities according to severity and risk. Further, seeking to implement effective management, control, and protection, Lotus Technology has established a centralized, organization-wide view of information assets. Lotus Technology has instituted cybersecurity risk monitoring policies to detect threats and cybersecurity risks to its enterprise information assets and products.", "Lotus Technology has implemented cybersecurity monitoring capabilities that collect and analyze telemetries from a wide range of sources and take proactive actions to ensure the security risk visualization of its systems and products. Lotus Technology's cloud security policies seek to enable secure cloud architecture deployments and extend security capabilities. Utilizing signed certificates, encryption keys, message authentication codes, and cryptographic algorithms, Lotus Technology adopts authentication and encryption to secure its products, software, vehicles and their components, and OTA updates. Additionally, Lotus Technology utilizes pre-condition checks, sequence and dependency execution, and failure recovery when performing updates during the OTA process. Lotus Technology's vehicle development involves a significant degree of automation and technology. With that level of complexity and interconnectivity in mind, Lotus Technology is building cybersecurity by the TARA process into its vehicle development process itself, with the intent of enabling the business to remain resilient to any potential attacks during vehicle development. The objective of Lotus Technology's privacy policies is to facilitate beneficial uses of data to improve its products and services while preserving customers’ privacy expectations and complying with applicable law. Global privacy laws and practices will guide the operational design, controls, procedures, and policies for Lotus Technology's program.", "If automobile data handlers collect data from individuals outside the vehicle for the purpose of ensuring driving safety, but are unable to obtain consent from such individuals, automobile data handlers shall anonymize the data by means such as deleting pictures containing identifiable natural persons or partially contouring the facial information in the pictures. According to the PRC Personal Information Protection Law adopted by the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress on August 20, 2021, and implemented from November 1, 2021, the personal information of natural persons shall be protected by law. As the first systematic and comprehensive law specifically for the protection of personal information in the PRC, the Personal Information Protection Law provides, among others, that (i) an individual’s separate consent shall be obtained before the operation of such individual’s sensitive personal information, e.g., biometric characteristics and individual location tracking, (ii) personal information operators handling sensitive personal information shall notify individuals of the necessity of such operations and the influence on the individuals’ rights, (iii) if personal information operators reject individuals’ requests to exercise their rights, individuals may file a lawsuit with a People’s Court."]
